import json,platform,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
trace=Path("/sys/kernel/tracing")
avail=(trace/"available_events").read_text().splitlines()
filters=(trace/"available_filter_functions").read_text().splitlines()
syms=(Path("/proc/kallsyms").read_text().splitlines())
fmt={}
for e in ("block_io_start","block_io_done","block_rq_issue","block_rq_complete"):
 p=trace/"events/block"/e/"format"
 fmt[e]=p.read_text() if p.is_file() else None
bio=Path("/usr/sbin/biolatency-bpfcc")
lines=bio.read_text().splitlines()
bcc=Path("/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/bcc/__init__.py")
bcc_lines=bcc.read_text().splitlines()
start=next(i for i,x in enumerate(bcc_lines) if "def get_kprobe_functions" in x)
print(json.dumps({"kernelRelease":platform.release(),"eventAvailability":[x for x in avail if x in ["block:block_io_start","block:block_io_done","block:block_rq_issue","block:block_rq_complete"]],"filterFunctions":[x.split()[0] for x in filters if re.match(r"^(__)?blk_account_io_done$",x.split()[0]) or re.match(r"^blk_(mq_end_request|update_request)$",x.split()[0])],"kallsyms":[x.split()[-1] for x in syms if len(x.split())>=3 and re.match(r"^(__)?blk_account_io_done$",x.split()[-1])],"tracepointFormats":fmt,"biolatencyFallbackSource":"\n".join(lines[287:296]),"bccKprobeFunctionDiscovery":"\n".join(bcc_lines[start:start+70])},sort_keys=True))
